definitions: Standard three-tick 20 Hz extrema/discontinuities; darts use a three-tick displacement and six-tick max velocity envelope. Raw rich rows are observations around the exact event. stride is the distance-derived tier at observation time; heldFor/heldTicks and motion.delta are actual schedule observations. Marks in surrounding rows must be considered, not just endpoint wall. Original windows lack fields that were not recorded. A linked timestamp does not establish unobscured footage; inspect clip receipts and explicit coverage notes.

originalAfter.definition: Standard analyzer: first row and ticks divisible by 3; >12 m/s resets previous; max turn over tick delta/60. Original trace lacks raw position, intent and stride fields; never infer those retrospectively.

originalBefore.description: Every original before-arm cloaker >12 m/s event using standard 20 Hz selection and reset. Original meter did not record raw body, intended velocity, step or recovery fields.
